name: Naracoorte
objection: Wikivoyage's own See entries for the town are thin (museum, gallery); draw is the caves.

name: Beachport
objection: Only one counted source and the main sights are separate spots.

name: Penola
objection: For: base for Coonawarra, Mary MacKillop centre. Against: one weak source, cellar doors are not spots.

name: Millicent
objection: For: large well-regarded museum and gateway to Canunda. Against: town unnamed by Wikivoyage; museum is the real spot.

name: Port MacDonnell
objection: Single source; no named sights on the sources I opened.

name: Southend
objection: One counted source; Wikivoyage's Southend page is Southend-on-Sea, not this place.

name: Bordertown
objection: For: white kangaroos are a quirky roadside draw. Against: that draw is the park, not the town; judge the wildlife park as its own place.

name: Cave Garden / Thugi
objection: Short visit, ~20 min, in town beside the arts centre.

name: Little Blue Lake
objection: Two sources but a short stop and seasonal swimming; private land access.

name: Kilsby Sinkhole
objection: For: one of Australia's significant dive sites, in two counted sources. Against: it is a guided/operator experience, certification needed.

name: Valley Lake / Ketla Malpi
objection: Near duplicate of the Blue Lake crater precinct; family picnic stop.

name: Mount Schank
objection: Moderate climb; descent into the crater not recommended.

name: Old Mount Gambier Gaol
objection: For: heritage gaol. Against: accommodation business, one source.

name: Ewens Ponds
objection: Snorkelling closed three months a year; permit needed to dive.

name: Piccaninnie Ponds
objection: For: well-known dive site and beach walk. Against: the main draw is closed; only a walk remains.

name: Tantanoola Caves
objection: Smaller, single-cave visit.

name: Canunda National Park
objection: None serious; 4WD only for some sections.

name: Little Dip Conservation Park
objection: Low views, many parts 4WD.

name: Beachport Conservation Park
objection: Part of the Beachport coast; moderate overlap with Pool of Siloam drive.

name: Victoria Fossil Cave
objection: For: the headline cave tour, separately ticketed. Against: part of a larger spot (rule 3).

name: Sheep's Back Museum
objection: For: open museum with counted listing. Against: local museum, one source.

name: Bool Lagoon
objection: Often dry; boardwalk can end far from water.

name: Mount Monster Conservation Park
objection: For: two counted sources. Against: low-profile park, short stop.

name: Robe Lighthouse
objection: For: Obelisk is a coastal landmark. Against: the guide itself downplays it; short stop.

name: Robe Customs House Maritime Museum
objection: One counted source and a small museum with limited hours; a visitor in a hurry skips it.

name: Long Beach, Robe
objection: Single counted source; an ordinary long beach.

name: Cape Dombey Obelisk
objection: Reported fenced off for erosion, so may be viewable from a distance only; short visit.

name: Big Lobster (Larry the Lobster)
objection: Ten-minute stop.

name: Cape Jaffa Lighthouse
objection: Tours only in school holidays; exterior otherwise.

name: Kingston National Trust Museum
objection: Not reliably open.

name: Mary MacKillop Interpretive Centre
objection: Single-topic museum; mainly of interest to pilgrims, but Penola's main sight.

name: Beachport Jetty
objection: A jetty is a short walk; but it is the town's landmark.

name: Beachport Woolstores Museum
objection: Small museum with variable hours.

name: Southend Beach
objection: Single source; a quiet fishing village.

name: Brown Beach
objection: Near-duplicate of Southend as a beach stop.

name: Cape Northumberland Lighthouse
objection: Source is an older newspaper guide and only one counted source; lighthouse access is exterior.

name: Port MacDonnell Maritime Museum
objection: Small local museum.

name: Wynns Coonawarra Estate
objection: Cellar door is a business.

name: Dingley Dell Museum
objection: Not there whenever you arrive.

name: Mount Schank Scenic Walk
objection: Single counted source; short walk.
